description: Part two-storey rear extension & external steps to existing rear raised garden level. [Non-material amendment to planning reference PA25/3372 to change the design of the lower ground floor rear and side windows/doors, and allow for minor increase to the width of one of the rear windows to the house (ground floor, utility room). This will increase the width of the ground floor utility room from 90cm to 1.1m - i.e. by 20cms, to align with the width of the other window on the ground floor. Change design of Lower Ground Floor rear and side windows/doors.]
